entities.summary: Changchun Stadium, also known as Nanling Stadium, is a multi-purpose stadium in Changchun, Jilin, China. It is predominantly used for football matches. Originally opened in 1992, the stadium has a maximum capacity of 41,638. It is currently the home of Changchun Yatai of the Chinese Super League, who returned to the stadium after previously playing there during the 2000s.
